runners.name: Good Golly Dolly
runners.comment: GOOD GOLLY DOLLY bumped BIG WHOOSH leaving the gate, prompted the pace from outside, ridden along through the far turn, put a head in front at the eighth pole and edged clear from SUGAR REIGN in the final sixteenth.

runners.name: Sugar Reign
runners.comment: SUGAR REIGN showed the way under pressure from GOOD GOLLY DOLLY to the outside, maintained a short lead under urging around the second bend, relinquished the lead at the eighth pole, yielded to GOOD GOLLY DOLLY in deep stretch but was clearly second best.

runners.name: Remember April
runners.comment: REMEMBER APRIL stalked in the three path around the first turn, went two wide into the far turn, angled to the rail then steered back out, came three wide into the stretch, failed to produce a bid but kept on for a clear third.

runners.name: Lady Ruth
runners.comment: LADY RUTH chased in the four path around the clubhouse turn, went three deep into the second bend, moved to the two path then got floated out to the four path by an angling REMEMBER APRIL, steered in upper stretch and tired.

runners.name: Big Whoosh
runners.comment: BIG WHOOSH got jostled leaving the gate and dropped back, trailed five wide around the first turn, stayed well off the rail up the backstretch, rounded the far turn four then three wide and was never a factor.

runners.name: Union Heiress
runners.comment: UNION HEIRESS followed from off the rail the rail into the first turn then angled to the inside, moved off the fence a bit around the bend, dropped back under urging along the rail on the far turn and tired.

runners.name: Big If
runners.comment: BIG IF broke in and bumped, pressed the pace from outside, dueled around the turn and into the lane, battled through the final furlong and dug in to edge the runner-up.

runners.name: Vern Gosdin
runners.comment: VERN GOSDIN broke well then ducked in shortly after, straightened course and went up to take a short lead from BIG IF, fought head to head with that rival around the bend, battled down the lane and yielded grudgingly in deep stretch.

runners.name: Swervedriver
runners.comment: SWERVEDRIVER tracked the top pair from off the rail, pursued in the two path on the turn, finished willingly down the lane and held third.

runners.name: Smokem Wicked
runners.comment: SMOKEM WICKED checked shortly after the start when VERN GOSDIN ducked in, got crowded along the rail and shuffled back by LUKA'S CHOICE early, trailed then went between rivals leaving the backstretch, picked up stride three then four wide on the turn, showed late interest and almost got by SWERVEDRIVER for third.

runners.name: Olympian Thirst
runners.comment: OLYMPIAN THIRST bobbled a bit at the start, raced in mid-pack off the rail, dropped back two then three wide on the turn and lacked a response down the lane.

runners.name: Luka's Choice
runners.comment: LUKA'S CHOICE coaxed from the gate then paused briefly when VERN GOSDIN crossed in front shortly after, chased from inside off the pace, saved ground around the bend and failed to menace.

runners.name: Sip Sip Charly
runners.comment: SIP SIP CHARLY got bumped back by outer rival at the start, chased from off the pace staying away from the rail, navigated the turn four then five wide and was never a factor.

runners.name: Ellen Jorth
runners.comment: ELLEN JORTH stalked inside, coxed along in the two path on the far turn, tipped three wide into the lane, drew alongside the leader shortly after, cleared with a sixteenth remaining and stayed strong to the wire.

runners.name: Princess Snow
runners.comment: PRINCESS SNOW got crowded at the start, settled in the two path, moved into range on the backstretch, angled out in upper stretch, chased determinedly through the final furlong but had to settle for second best.

runners.name: Dorie Miller
runners.comment: DORIE MILLER bothered between rivals at the start, lagged behind on the inside into the first turn, crept closer in the middle stages, stayed on the fence around the far turn, tipped out into the lane, cut back inside at the eighth pole and gained third.

runners.name: Tiger of the Sea
runners.comment: TIGER OF THE SEA bobbled a bit leaving the gate but still came away well, rated in the two path around the first turn, went up to challenge for the lead on the outside in the middle stages, took over on the far turn and cleared a quarter mile out, challenged by ELLEN JORTH at the top of the stretch, lost command midstretch and weakened in the last sixteenth.

runners.name: Kool Mariah
runners.comment: KOOL MARIAH stalked in the three path then moved in a bit around the first turn, chased three deep around the second bend and weakened down the lane.

runners.name: Midnight Cowgirl
runners.comment: MIDNIGHT COWGIRL sped clear and crossed over to the inside, headed by TIGER OF THE SEA on the backstretch, fought to the five-sixteenths pole, failed to kick on with the new leader late on the bend and retreated in the stretch.

runners.name: Penny the Jet
runners.comment: PENNY THE JET pressed three deep up the backstretch, took over on the turn, dueled outside CINDYS BEACH HOUSE past the five-sixteenths pole, edged clear into the final furlong and padded the margin late.

runners.name: Cindys Beach House
runners.comment: CINDYS BEACH HOUSE vied for the lead inside a pair of rivals, dueled with PENNY THE JET past the five-sixteenths pole, could not keep touch with the winner into the furlong grounds but stayed on for a clear second.

runners.name: Cherry Candy
runners.comment: CHERRY CANDY vied between rivals to the three-eighths pole, could not keep up with the top pair midway around the bend, chased two then three wide to the stretch, kept trying through the lane and held third.

runners.name: Kizazi
runners.comment: KIZAZI chased inside a trio of rivals from off the pace, got crowded by I'M LOVESTRUCK through the turn, cut the corner into the lane and kept on to earn a minor award.

runners.name: Quick Sip
runners.comment: QUICK SIP chased outside a pair of rivals in the early going, came four wide into the lane and faded.

runners.name: Jobarb
runners.comment: JOBARB broke a step slow, chased four deep to the turn, five wide into the stretch and tired.

runners.name: I'm Lovestruck
runners.comment: I'M LOVESTRUCK chased two wide to the turn, remained in the two path around the bend and came up empty in the lane.

runners.name: Whatastarr (IRE)
runners.comment: WHATASTARR (IRE) trailed up the backstretch, took the turn three then four wide and never got involved.

runners.name: Shining River (GB)
runners.comment: SHINING RIVER (GB) stalked in the two path around the first turn, moved inside on the backstretch, lost some ground into the far turn, angled three wide around the far turn, came with a late bid and nailed JENNYS WINE GIRL in the closing moments.

runners.name: Jennys Wine Girl
runners.comment: JENNYS WINE GIRL dueled from outside, cleared in upper stretch, showed the way into the last sixteenth, got run down by rivals on both sides late and nailed by the winner.

runners.name: Glory'z Clubhouse
runners.comment: GLORY'Z CLUBHOUSE unhurried in the opening stages along the inside, saved ground to the stretch, rallied up the rail but ran out of ground.

runners.name: Suntory Time
runners.comment: SUNTORY TIME stalked three deep between rivals on the clubhouse turn, raced two wide between in the middle stages, saved ground through the far turn, chased willingly through the lane and lacked the needed late punch.

runners.name: Rehearsal (IRE)
runners.comment: REHEARSAL (IRE) dueled for command from inside, fought through the far turn, yielded in upper stretch and flattened out in the late stages.

runners.name: Angelica Bay (IRE)
runners.comment: ANGELICA BAY (IRE) stalked four deep through the first turn, three deep up the backstretch, chased two wide on the far turn, pursued in range to the sixteenth pole and lacked a late bid.

runners.name: Ziggity Zag
runners.comment: ZIGGITY ZAG settled inside, ridden along through the far turn, moved off the fence at the top of the stretch, lacked room behind rivals, angled inward and ran into more traffic late and could not regain momentum.

runners.name: Humidity
runners.comment: HUMIDITY settled outside a rival, remained two wide around the far turn, moved out a bit in upper stretch and failed to menace.

runners.name: Himari
runners.comment: HIMARI broke out, stalked for a bit then went up to vie three deep, fought in the two path between rivals around the bend, dug in while drifting out in the final furlong and edged CLARINA for the victory.

runners.name: Clarina
runners.comment: CLARINA broke out, raced up close four deep, vied outside a pair of rivals in the four path around the bend, put a head in front midstretch, battled while drifting out in the late stages and got edged by HIMARI at the wire.

runners.name: Kinzlee'scharisma
runners.comment: KINZLEE'SCHARISMA tracked from inside then angled out, chased three to four wide around the bend, showed a mild rally and got up for third.

runners.name: Mimi's Memory
runners.comment: MIMI'S MEMORY dueled from outside then vied between up the backstretch, fought along the rail on the turn, resisted into the final furlong, lost command midstretch and yielded grudgingly late.

runners.name: Artisma
runners.comment: ARTISMA stumbled leaving the gate, tracked from off the rail, went two to three wide early on the turn then angled to the inside, moved out in the lane and lacked a rally.

runners.name: Too Sassy
runners.comment: TOO SASSY dueled from inside, dropped back while moving to the two path on the turn and weakened in the stretch.

runners.name: Hazaka (FR)
runners.comment: HAZAKA (FR) stalked along the rail through both turns, given her cue at the top of the lane, surged to the front midstretch and held gamely over her stablemate in the final strides.

runners.name: Yep (GB)
runners.comment: YEP (GB) traveled in mid-pack along the rail, had to wait behind a rival on the far turn and brushed outer rival at the five-sixteenths pole, tipped two wide into the lane, angled out and rallied five deep into the final furlong, dueled with HAZAKA (FR) late and got denied.

runners.name: Go Ralph
runners.comment: GO RALPH reserved in the two path, launched a bid leaving the backstretch, came with a bold bid three deep on the far turn, led briefly in upper stretch before giving the advantage back to POSTMODERN at the eighth pole and was outkicked by the top pair in the last sixteenth.

runners.name: Alghero
runners.comment: ALGHERO trailed on the inside, went two wide into the far turn, gained ground while angling widest, chased five deep into the stretch, produced a mild rally and got up for a minor award.

runners.name: Grinders Switch
runners.comment: GRINDERS SWITCH raced in mid-pack outside a rival, chased two wide between foes on the far turn while taking light contact from inner rival at the five-sixteenths marker, three deep into the lane and failed to produce a bid.

runners.name: Postmodern
runners.comment: POSTMODERN set the pace along the inside, took pressure approaching the far turn, vied with outer pair on the far turn, lost command at the top of the lane, put a head back in front at the eighth pole, surrendered the lead for the final time midstretch and weakened.

runners.name: Khonsu
runners.comment: KHONSU was closest in pursuit in the two path in the opening stages, drew alongside the leader leaving the backstretch, vied between runners around the second bend and weakened in the final furlong.

runners.name: Peace On Earth
runners.comment: PEACE ON EARTH sat off the pace on the inside, gained two, three, then four wide on the far turn and flattened out in lane.

runners.name: Grand Slam Smile
runners.comment: GRAND SLAM SMILE came away cleanly while last away, move up quickly to duel for command on the inside, inched ahead ISSA COURT into the turn, put that rival away with a quarter mile remaining, kicked away in upper stretch and padded the lead under right handed urging and steady handling.

runners.name: Big Hug
runners.comment: BIG HUG brushed with CLUBHOUSE CUTIE in the beginning, trailed early, asked three then four wide around the bend, showed late run and got up for second.

runners.name: She's No Quant
runners.comment: SHE'S NO QUANT stalked the top pair outside a pair of rivals, picked up stride and drew closer in the three path on the turn, watched GRAND SLAM SMILE draw away in upper stretch and could not hold on for second.

runners.name: Clubhouse Cutie
runners.comment: CLUBHOUSE CUTIE brushed BIG HUG leaving the gate, chased the dueling leaders from between runners, bumped LINO'S ANGEL and took up in tight quarters early on the turn, chased three wide into the lane and could not threaten.

runners.name: Issa Court
runners.comment: ISSA COURT dueled from outside to the turn, kept the pressure on the winner to the five-sixteenths pole, failed to keep up with a quarter mile left to run and faded through the stretch.

runners.name: Lino's Angel
runners.comment: LINO'S ANGEL bobbled slightly and out a bit leaving the gate, stalked the leaders inside a pair of rivals, bumped with CLUBHOUSE CUTIE early on the turn, saved ground to the stretch and tired.

runners.name: Channel Place
runners.comment: CHANNEL PLACE was closest in pursuit in the two path early, applied pressure to the leader into the far turn, headed JASMINE at the quarter pole, took a narrow lead in upper stretch and drove clear in the final sixteenth.

runners.name: Jasmine
runners.comment: JASMINE established the front and controlled the pace next to the fence, took pressure with three furlongs left to run, headed at the quarter pole, lost command while battling in upper stretch and yielded to the winner in the late stages.

runners.name: Jet Black Jewel (IRE)
runners.comment: JET BLACK JEWEL (IRE) tracked from inside out of range of the pacesetter, waited along the rail then in the two path on the far turn, roused into the lane and ran on for third.

runners.name: Musical Song
runners.comment: MUSICAL SONG followed in range in the two path, came under a ride midway around the far turn, moved out in the lane and lacked a bid.

runners.name: Cat The Confidante (IRE)
runners.comment: CAT THE CONFIDANTE (IRE) unhurried in the opening rounds and tucked inside, exited the backstretch in the two path, eased over to the three path at the quarter pole, swung wide for the stretch and kept on to improve position.

runners.name: Specialty
runners.comment: SPECIALTY sat off the pace on the inside, moved off the rail on the backstretch, chased two then three wide on the second bend, steered out in the lane and lacked further response.

runners.name: Lanilla
runners.comment: LANILLA reserved on the inside, two wide on the backstretch, gained three then four wide around the second bend, tipped out at the top of the lane and flattened out.

runners.name: Unusualexis
runners.comment: UNUSUALEXIS stalked from inside, coxed along on the far turn, asked left handed at the top of the lane and weakened.

runners.name: Interplay
runners.comment: INTERPLAY content to trail the field in the early going, raced along the rail around the clubhouse turn, traveled in the three path leaving the backstretch, got floated out approaching the quarter pole and was never a factor.
